newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 16.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 16.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 47.39 points to close at 7333.55.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index fell 31.22 points or 2.91 percent to 1,041.27.
* Ringgit strengthened to 2.4765/85 a dollar at 0110 GMT, against 2.5065/75 at end of Kuala Lumpur trading on Thursday.
* The dollar finished firm against the yen in New York on Thursday at 115.75/85 against 115.40/50 previously. Around 0120 GMT, dollar rose further, being quoted at 0120 GMT at 116.65/75.
* Regional markets mostly firm in early trading, with gains in Tokyo, Singapore and Australia.
